fieldValues.title: muDemocracy.org main CI red since 2026-11-19: relay writes carry no actor, and red saves merge unchecked
fieldValues.summary: 25 Tier-2 records written through the MuSRS relay on 2026-11-19 (17) and 2026-11-23 (8) have no createdBy, because srs-relay.service set no SRS_ACTOR, and coherence rule 12 fails on them. Every save merged red: clerk save runs only srs repo validate, and main is unprotected. Every later PR inherited the failure. createdBy cannot be set after creation (RFC-046) and AGENTS.md forbade authored-by, so there was no permitted repair.
evidence: muDemocracy.org CI runs 44479330834 (first red, 2 ERROR lines) to 45369760446 (2026-11-24, 25 errors)
muDemocracy.org#515, PR #516 (the repair), PR #514 (red for this reason)
Same cause of unchecked saves in the editor: srs-web#793
